title: 运动与健康饮食的作用（练习1·09）
question: Some people believe that regular physical exercise is the most effective way to improve people's health, while others think that maintaining a healthy diet is more important. Discuss both views and give your own opinion.
logic: ▪ 比较运动与饮食并主张结合。▪ 运动：体能、代谢和心理收益。▪ 饮食：营养、能量与血压；解释互补。▪ 结论：可持续双重习惯。

source_nine.en: Some regard regular exercise as the best route to better health, while others favour a healthy diet. Both views have merit, but I would not identify either as universally superior. Exercise and nutrition support different aspects of well-being, so combining them offers a more convincing long-term approach.
source_nine.cn: 一些人认为规律运动是改善健康的最佳途径，另一些人更看重健康饮食。两者都有道理，但我不会认为任一方在所有情境都更优。运动和营养支持不同健康方面，结合更有利于长期健康。

source_nine.en: Exercise improves physical fitness by strengthening the cardiovascular system and muscles. Regular activity can also help regulate blood sugar and support weight management, thereby reducing some risks associated with inactivity. Its contribution to psychological well-being matters too. Walking, sport or other enjoyable movement can relieve stress, improve mood and support sleep. These benefits help explain why people facing demanding work or study schedules may regard exercise as particularly valuable. However, activity alone cannot ensure that a person's nutritional needs are met.
source_nine.cn: 运动增强心血管和肌肉系统，改善体能。规律活动也帮助调节血糖和管理体重，降低部分久坐相关风险。对心理健康的贡献也很重要。步行、体育或其他喜欢的活动能缓解压力、改善情绪并促进睡眠。因此，面对繁重工作或学习的人可能特别看重运动。不过，单靠运动无法确保营养需要得到满足。

source_nine.en: Supporters of a healthy diet emphasise that the body requires adequate protein, vitamins, minerals and other nutrients for normal functioning. Food choices also affect overall energy intake, so a balanced diet can help people avoid consuming more energy than they use. Different dietary changes have different purposes: reducing excessive salt intake, for example, can support blood-pressure control rather than directly prevent weight gain. Diet nevertheless cannot substitute for all the cardiovascular and muscular benefits of movement. Equally, exercising regularly does not cancel out every consequence of persistently poor eating habits. The relative priority may vary with a person's circumstances, but treating the two as alternatives overlooks how they complement each other. Encouraging sustainable habits in both areas is therefore more useful than promoting a single solution for everyone.
source_nine.cn: 支持健康饮食的人强调，人体需要充足蛋白质、维生素、矿物质等营养以正常运作。食物选择也影响总能量摄入，因此均衡饮食有助于避免摄入超过消耗。不同调整目的不同，例如减少过量盐摄入能支持血压控制，而非直接防止增重。但饮食不能取代运动对心血管和肌肉的所有益处。同样，经常运动也不能抵消长期不良饮食的每项后果。相对优先度可能随个人情况变化，但将两者视为替代品，忽略了互补关系。因此，鼓励两方面的可持续习惯，比向所有人推广单一方案更有用。

source_nine.en: In conclusion, exercise and healthy eating each make an important contribution to health. A combination of regular activity and balanced nutrition is a stronger general strategy than expecting either one to compensate fully for neglecting the other.
source_nine.cn: 总之，运动和健康饮食都对健康有重要贡献。规律活动与均衡营养结合，比期望一方完全弥补对另一方的忽视更可靠。

source_seven.en: Nowadays, people are paying increasing attention to ways of improving their health. Some argue that regular exercise is the most effective way to maintain good health, while others believe that a healthy diet is more important. This essay will discuss both views and argue that, on balance, combining regular exercise with a healthy diet offers the greatest benefits.
source_seven.cn: 如今人们越来越关注改善健康的方法。一些人认为规律运动最有效，另一些人认为健康饮食更重要。本文将讨论双方观点，并主张总体上将规律运动与健康饮食结合能带来最大收益。

source_seven.en: Regular exercise plays an important role in improving physical fitness, supporting metabolic health and promoting psychological well-being. Physically, it strengthens the cardiovascular system and muscles, while helping the body regulate blood sugar and use energy more efficiently. These benefits can help people maintain a healthy weight and reduce the risk of chronic diseases such as type 2 diabetes. Exercise also benefits mental health by relieving stress and improving mood, particularly among people who feel overwhelmed by work or study. In addition, regular physical activity can improve sleep quality, contributing to better overall well-being.
source_seven.cn: 规律运动对改善体能、支持代谢健康及促进心理健康很重要。身体方面，它能增强心血管系统和肌肉，并帮助调节血糖、更高效地利用能量。这些收益有助于保持健康体重并降低2型糖尿病等慢性病风险。运动也能缓解压力、改善情绪，尤其惠及因工作或学习感到不堪重负的人。此外，规律活动能改善睡眠，从而促进整体健康。

source_seven.en: A healthy diet is equally important because it provides essential nutrients, helps maintain a healthy weight and reduces the risk of diet-related diseases. Foods rich in protein, vitamins and minerals support growth, tissue repair and normal bodily functions, ensuring that people meet their daily nutritional needs. In addition, limiting excessive energy intake from sugary or energy-dense foods can help prevent weight gain, while reducing excessive salt intake can help control blood pressure. However, diet and exercise are most effective when combined, as they support different aspects of health. People may still gain weight if they consume too much unhealthy food, even if they exercise regularly. Conversely, a balanced diet alone cannot provide the cardiovascular and muscular benefits of physical activity. Therefore, maintaining long-term health requires attention to both eating habits and exercise routines.
source_seven.cn: 健康饮食同样重要，因为它提供必要营养，帮助维持健康体重并降低饮食相关疾病风险。富含蛋白质、维生素和矿物质的食物支持生长、组织修复和正常身体功能，满足日常营养需要。此外，控制来自含糖或高能量食物的过量能量摄入，有助于预防体重增加，而减少过量盐摄入有助于控制血压。不过，饮食和运动结合最有效，因为它们支持不同健康方面。即使经常运动，吃太多不健康食物仍可能增重。反之，单靠均衡饮食无法提供运动对心血管和肌肉的益处。因此，长期健康需要同时关注饮食习惯和运动安排。

source_seven.en: In conclusion, regular exercise and a healthy diet play complementary roles in maintaining good health. Combining the two is therefore the most effective way to support long-term physical and mental well-being.
source_seven.cn: 总之，规律运动和健康饮食对保持健康发挥互补作用。结合两者是支持长期身心健康的最有效方式。

source_models.original:
Nowadays, people are paying increasing attention to ways of improving their health. Some argue that regular exercise is the most effective way to maintain good health, while others believe that a healthy diet is more important. This essay will discuss both views and argue that, on balance, combining regular exercise with a healthy diet offers the greatest benefits.

Regular exercise plays an important role in improving physical fitness, supporting metabolic health and promoting psychological well-being. Physically, it strengthens the cardiovascular system and muscles, while helping the body regulate blood sugar and use energy more efficiently. These benefits can help people maintain a healthy weight and reduce the risk of chronic diseases such as diabetes. Exercise also benefits mental health by relieving stress and improving mood, particularly among people who feel overwhelmed by work or study. In addition, regular physical activity can improve sleep quality, contributing to better overall well-being.

A healthy diet is equally important because it provides essential nutrients, helps maintain a healthy weight and reduces the risk of diet-related diseases. Foods rich in protein, vitamins and minerals support growth, tissue repair and normal bodily functions, ensuring that people meet their daily nutritional needs. In addition, limiting excessive sugar, salt and unhealthy fats can help prevent weight gain and reduce the risk of obesity. However, diet and exercise are most effective when combined, as they support different aspects of health. People may still gain weight if they consume too much unhealthy food, even if they exercise regularly. Conversely, a balanced diet alone cannot provide the cardiovascular and muscular benefits of physical activity. Therefore, maintaining long-term health requires attention to both eating habits and exercise routines.

In conclusion, regular exercise and a healthy diet play complementary roles in maintaining good health. Combining the two is therefore the most effective way to support long-term physical and mental well-being.
